response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_cnt FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT healtheval, site_cnt, site_cnt * 1.0 / SUM(site_cnt) OVER () AS share FROM per_status), with_avg AS (SELECT healtheval, site_cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(site_cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM with_avg WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The average share is computed over all statuses (including the NULL group) before filtering. The three outputs are then averaged over only the statuses whose share is above that overall average.
If no status has a share above the average (for example, when all shares are equal), the query returns a single row of NULLs.
